control.description: Change one recorded model output so it no longer contains the accepted answer; the rescored value differs from the recorded one.

does_not_cover: Whether the model gives these outputs. That is re-execution (gpu-8gb, Ollama 0.35.1, qwen2.5:7b manifest 845dbda0), listed in RECHECK.md and not automated. The recompute reuses the maker's code, so it is not an independent implementation.
